history_summary: Record four native species-reference correspondences in the six-stock wheat crown-rot SMC.
history_details: Add the declared Bacillus spizizenii PM9, Bacillus rugosus PM16 and S32, and Bacillus halotolerans S8 reference correspondences. PM16 and S32 remain distinct experimental stocks despite their common species lookup. Preserve every culture deposit and marker, the unselected BS-Z15 and fungal T19 members, the challenged pathogen's separate role, all source evidence and historical initial-curation notes. Reference genome populations do not establish stock assemblies or revise experiment timing, colonization, metabolite or causal claims; issue1945 remains separate. Only four selected GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All previous history remains unchanged, and this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
